source_title: MEDKids Nose starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
educational_content: The nose helps us smell. Air goes in and out through the nose. Smells travel into the nose with the air. The nose sends smell messages to the brain. Tiny hairs and mucus in the nose catch dust and germs. Smell helps us enjoy the taste of food.
learning_objectives: The nose sends smell messages to the brain.
Hairs and mucus in the nose catch dust and germs.

forbidden_claims.claim: Picking your nose keeps it clean
